provenance.method: Loaded and answered Who spoke when at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Who spoke when requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Who spoke when requests on a 3.3 s speech-and-music clip.

Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Who spoke when request on a 3.3 s speech-and-music clip.
